summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results, including sales of £7.6 billion (+2% AER; +5% CER), total operating profit of £2,293 million (+3% AER; +9% CER), and EPS of 43.2p (+9% AER; +15% CER). The filing also announced a 17p quarterly dividend, a £2 billion share buyback programme (£1.7 billion executed to date), pipeline acquisitions (ozureprubart for food allergies; HS235 for pulmonary hypertension), and reaffirmed 2026 guidance (turnover growth 3–5%, core operating profit growth 7–9%, core EPS growth 7–9%). This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premium, or special-situation mechanics are present.
